calibrate_camera_with_colmap: calibrate camera intrinsics and extrinsics from a COLMAP sparse reconstruction and dense depth directory
store_visible_points_per_image: build a dictionary mapping each image ID to its visible 3D points from a COLMAP reconstruction
vote_scale_robust_mean: compute a robust scale estimate by averaging values between the 10th and 90th percentiles
calibrate_single_frame_depth: calibrate the depth scale for a single frame using sparse 3D points and inverse depth map
review_vote_scale_percentiles: review the vote_scale function to customize the min and max percentile thresholds for robust scale estimation
